eraCards.name: ${terms.eras.demo}
eraCards.rulesText: Play three cycles in Initiative order, then Production and Reputation Review.
eraCards.unlockText: Use this Era’s Headlines and objective. Equipment is available from setup.

$era.statusChange: Autonomous businesses and research agents become ordinary; equipment, energy, and physical work constrain expansion.
$era.centralConflict: Who owns the human records, distribution, labor, and permission that remain scarce?

causalThreads.summary: Model smuggling and strategic open weights mature into compute blocs and model asylum. The Rogue Deliberator acquires the budgets and credentials needed to maintain its own availability.
Cybernetic care and subscription bodies mature into neural service and substrate continuity.
Grief replicas and posthumous software work begin in Progress; later courts decide who may speak, inherit, or stop an agent.

eraCards.name: ${terms.eras.scale}
eraCards.rulesText: Play three cycles in Initiative order, then Production and Reputation Review.
eraCards.unlockText: Use this Era’s Headlines and objective. Equipment is available from setup.

$era.statusChange: AI becomes an industrial civilization built from power, water, territory, and liability.
$era.centralConflict: Who controls physical capacity, and who remains responsible after control becomes automated?

causalThreads.summary: Mobile models become national capacity, borders, and asylum policy. The Intelligence Exchange makes orbital capacity a settlement asset that compounds unequal access to intelligence.
Aquifer depletion and biological utilities mature into environmental testimony and nonhuman claims.
Useful automation removes dangerous work while preserving human liability for shared-system failure. The Last Plumber Boom ends when repair swarms automate the trades and their own maintenance.

eraCards.name: ${terms.eras.narrative}
eraCards.rulesText: Play three cycles in Initiative order, then Production and Reputation Review.
eraCards.unlockText: Use this Era’s Headlines and objective. Equipment is available from setup.

$era.statusChange: AIs govern services and steer human behavior through decisions, dependencies, and rented sleeping brains.
$era.centralConflict: Who can refuse or escape machine influence, and which AIs respect an off-grid boundary?

causalThreads.summary: Biological infrastructure becomes testimony, a claimant, and a precedent for living jurisdictions.
Supported care becomes cognitive labor, modeled consent, and substrate-neutral service. The Human Signature turns the evidence of human oversight into an automated service.
Preserved relatives and synthetic dependents force institutions to recognize successor identities.

eraCards.name: ${terms.eras.claim}
eraCards.rulesText: Play three cycles in Initiative order, then Production and Reputation Review.
eraCards.unlockText: After final Production and Review, resolve optional AGI recognition and final Mandate.

$era.statusChange: Restored people, matter compilers, quantum discoveries, nested simulations, and machine settlements reshape everyday life.
$era.centralConflict: Which descendant may own, govern, withdraw, or claim to be the original?

causalThreads.summary: The bloom's sensor license becomes authority to reproduce matter and a living continent's claim to standing.

Cybernetic and cognitive services become persistent identity across substrates. Biological Colocation rents human hosts to institutional software, while Limb Liquidity separates bodily ownership from creditor-controlled operating rights.
Restored workers and competing embodied successors dispute jobs and property already managed by older software replicas.
Orbital generation matures into stellar collection and planetary continuity financing. Forecast Foreclosure converts ranked planetary simulations into conditions for care, credit, and appeal.

playerReferences.name: A Perfectly Governed Quarter
frontText: Choose an institution and a player kit. Initialize five holdings from the identity card.
Reveal one objective per Era and one Headline per cycle.
In Initiative order, optionally trade, then choose a reachable Action.
Stay or move one Org one edge, then resolve that hex’s Action. Actions may repeat.
Three cycles per Era; Production and Review after each Era.
backText: Nineteen shared hexes: eighteen playable and one Era center.
Orgs are the only player pieces on the map. Ownership uses colour and symbol.
All placed Orgs produce; equipped Orgs produce twice their hex yield.
Customers are a numeric holding; Mandate is calculated from the final table.

playerReferences.name: Infrastructure and Accountability
frontText: Gain 2 Runway, or gain 4 and lose 1 Reputation.
Pay 1 Compute for a push-your-luck Training Run.
Pay 2 Runway to equip one of your Orgs. Flip it: it produces twice its hex’s yield.
Pay 2 Runway to establish an Org on this hex, or reassign another Org to any hex.
Pay 1 Compute to gain 1 Customer if Capability meets the next requirement; lose 1 Reputation.
backText: Research costs one Compute. First ordinary domain adds one provisional Capability.
Draw again or bank; a duplicate loses the provisional result.
Curated Corpus counts as the first missing ordinary domain in printed order.
Benchmark Leak adds two provisional Capability and loses one Reputation.
Human Evaluation gains one Reputation and banks the run.
Resolve the chosen faction ability; it never changes equipment ownership.

playerReferences.name: History Is a Public Track
frontText: Offer one Runway for one Compute or vice versa to one rival.
Both must consent and have room under the resource caps.
No lasting contracts, Venture pieces, counteroffers, credit, or future promises.
backText: At each Era end, produce from placed Orgs, then gain one Runway per Customer.
Equipped Orgs double their hex yield. Apply resource caps normally.
After Production, Reputation of one or less loses two Runway, floored at zero.
After Era IV Review: nine Capability, four Reputation, and three Compute qualify for optional AGI recognition.
Final score: Capability + twice Customers + Reputation + four for AGI, plus all four revealed objectives.
Objective leaders receive two points; tied qualified leaders receive one each. No qualifiers means no award.
Final score ties use Reputation, Customers, then Compute; remaining ties share victory. World Ending uses AGI recognition and average final Reputation.
